blurb: New Orleans Lakefront Airport is a full-service airport preserving New Orleans' aviation history with Art Deco design. It offers comprehensive flight services including charter flights, flight instruction, and helicopter tours. The airport also serves as a venue for events such as airshows, corporate events, and weddings.

quotes.text: What a wonderful surprise this airport terminal is! We visited from Australia and our friends took us to visit. I love Art Deco history… and I love airports!
Great Terminal Staff. So many of my friends fly to NOLA using this airport.
